name: create-tauri-react
summary: Tauri desktop app template with Vite, React, TypeScript, Tailwind and shadcn/ui; Biome and Husky pre-commits.
description: A Tauri project template for building desktop apps with Tauri, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS (with shadcn/ui) in Vite. The architecture follows bulletproof-react practices: routes in src/app, pages built from src/features, pure UI components in src/components. Biome (via ultracite) handles linting and formatting, Husky + lint-staged run pre-commit hooks, and bun is the default package manager.
contains: Tauri + Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui) template
Biome (via ultracite) for linting and formatting; bun run check / bun run fix
bun by default, with steps to switch package manager
